title: A polynomial versus superpolynomial gap in vertex-distribution-free graph testing
review_type: Independent AI analytic review; not human peer review, formal proof certification or novelty certification.

independence.incidental_status_text: Authored supporting PROOF.md has a prior-audit status sentence in its preface; this was disregarded, and no linked audit was opened.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: P is K4-freeness intersected with deletion of at most one vertex to 3-colorability; it is fixed, hereditary, extendable and edge-deletion closed, with C3 contained in P.
For every nonempty epsilon-far graph and 0<epsilon<=1/8, r=h*ell independent uniform samples reject 3-colorability with probability>=11/12; duplicates identified.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Reconstructed list repair bound, nonnegative potential and conditional union bound over tree addresses; no large-input qualification.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: All-size n-oblivious canonical one-sided P tester uses O(epsilon^-6 log(1/epsilon)) samples and O(epsilon^-12 log²(1/epsilon)) adjacency queries.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Verified two disjoint witness case and coupon-collector case; no polynomial running-time assertion.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: For a 3-colorable n-vertex tail, heavy-apex weights 1/2 and 1/(2n) give exact P distance one quarter of uniform triangle distance, allowing arbitrary edge edits.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Verified both inequalities and necessity of tail premise; exact independent arbitrary-target checks passed.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: Three-part cover is 3-colorable, preserves triangle-freeness and loses at most factor9 in normalized triangle distance.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Verified deletion reduction and repair projection; source n=1 and duplicate original identities handled.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: Total VDF budget Q yields source triangle tester mentioning at most2Q source vertices at constant proximity rescaling, including adaptive queries and early stopping.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Verified exact sample and adjacency simulation; extra disclosed data independent of source edges.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: Adaptive two-sided undirected triangle testing has exp(Omega(log²(1/delta))) lower bound in the relevant dense oracle model.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Primary author manuscript model, Theorem4(ii), explicit undirected consequence and Section7 proof visually inspected after PDF font extraction failed.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: Along rational epsilon->0, worst-case total VDF cost is exp(Omega(log²(1/epsilon))) even with vertex set, n, positive weight vector and apex provided; no polynomial comparison to classical canonical complexity and1/epsilon.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Verified imported reduction and independently reconstructed explicit supporting hard family.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: Progression-free host, parity distributions and lazy permutation exposure yield explicit epsilon_d=K/(1152m), Q>=m^(1/3), log1/epsilon_d=Theta(d), logm=Theta(d²).
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Reconstructed sphere/carry, triangle, Chernoff, coupling, adaptive endpoint and rational scaling arguments.

exact_checked_claims.exact_claim: P is not blowup-avoidable via doubled odd wheel.
exact_checked_claims.assessment: Verified graph argument; public exact64-pattern control replayed.

gaps.description: No unresolved mathematical gap identified in the published theorem or checked supporting direct construction.
No human peer review, formal proof-assistant certificate or universal computational proof is supplied.
Confirmed primary problem/model and lower-bound theorem; did not independently certify the bounded priority audit, missing journal-version coverage or complete forward citations.

strongest_verified_result: For fixed P=K4-free intersect deletion-of-at-most-one-vertex-to-3-colorable, an n-oblivious all-size classical canonical tester has polynomial sample/query complexity, while adaptive two-sided VDF worst-case total sample-plus-adjacency cost is exp(Omega(log²(1/epsilon))) along a positive rational epsilon sequence, even with the vertex set, size, full positive distribution and apex known.
